messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "title": "Unreliable Save Functionality",
 "problem_statement": "Users across the claims and reports modules experience repeated failures when attempting to save data. This inconsistency forces multiple retries and causes significant frustration during critical workflow steps.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "quote": "Reports: click \"Save\", rage x3",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-09-22T09:41:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Claims: click \"Open\"\nClaims: click \"Save\", rage x3",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-10-20T13:34:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Reports: click \"Save\", rage x3",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-09-13T13:48:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Claim details: click \"Save\", rage x3",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-10-25T12:46:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Reports: click \"Save\", rage x3",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-10-29T10:23:00Z"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The evidence describes repeated save failures across the claims and reports modules, with five session quotes showing users clicking 'Save' followed by rage clicks (x3) between September and October 2026. This is a recurring in-product reliability problem affecting a critical workflow step, not a pricing, contract, IT, or staffing issue, and no help article would resolve a save failure. A squad could plausibly investigate and fix the save functionality. All items are consistent with a genuine product problem.","verdict": "pass"}
